name: Tetrahedral Marching Cubes Neighbor Lookup
aliases: Vertex neighbor lookup table around cube corner
definition: A lookup table providing anchor displacements ($\Delta_i$) and neighbor tetrahedron offsets ($t_i$) for vertices surrounding a specific cube corner, used to map tetrahedra for isosurface extraction.
summary: Tetrahedral Marching Cubes Neighbor Lookup is a precomputed table that maps cube corners to tetrahedron offsets, enabling fast neighbor identification during isosurface extraction on unstructured grids.
